text:
Type: white three-drawer chest
Use: storing clothes and small items; bedroom, hallway, guest room
Style: minimalist, Scandinavian, modern
Materials: white painted fiberboard, frosted glass panel, matching white bar handles
Colors: white, frosted milky glass
Shape: upright chest with three drawers, top front set with a frosted glass panel, lower fronts with recessed frame panels, long slim bar handles, recessed plinth, medium visual weight
Feel: fresh, light, tidy, simple
Goes with: light wood floors, grey or pastel textiles, white walls; Scandinavian or minimalist bedrooms

product.name: BRIMNES
product.description: Of course your home should be a safe place for the entire family. Thats why a safety fitting is included so that you can attach the chest of drawers to the wall.
